item.name: Race conditions
[0450] Race: POST +1 and DELETE of the same product fired at the same time (10 rounds); the cart never ends inconsistent → 200 OK.

exec: // RACE: while a line is being removed, another request adds one more unit of the same product.
// Each round: clean cart + 1 unit -> fire POST(+1) and DELETE(product) AT THE SAME TIME -> read the cart.
// Valid final states: the line is gone (POST ran first, then DELETE) or it holds exactly 1 unit
// (DELETE ran first, then POST re-created it). A line with 2 units means the DELETE was overwritten
// by a stale read (lost update); anything else is a consistency bug.

const seed = await send('POST', '/cart', { productId: productId, quantity: 1 });
const add = () => send('POST', '/cart', { productId: productId, quantity: 1 });
const addFirst = round % 2 === 1;                                        // alternate who leaves first
